operative_statistic: PR (participation ratio); eta2 dropped as degenerate

eta2_degeneracy_FINDING.explanation: x_c rows are class-mean-constant, so any class-resolved drive has eta2==1 exactly; eta2 cannot discriminate disjoint supports. PR is the operative spread statistic. This is a prereg-statistic correction CAUGHT by the able-to-fail screen, not a silent loosening — G1 already uses PR, so no Match#3 threshold changes.
